newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ansett International sees 96/97 A$50 mln loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ansett International sees 96/97 A$50 mln loss.

text.p: The international division of the carrier Ansett Holdings Ltd, Ansett International, said on Thursday it expected a loss of A$50 million in the 1996/97 year ending June 30.
"That's Ansett International's stand alone result," said Ansett International general manager Craig Wallace told a tourism conference.
He said that the international operations' loss would be offset by operating income from Ansett's domestic and other business .
"The loss is significantly reduced from there," Wallace said.
Ansett International is Ansett's fledgling regional carrier flying to seven Asian destinations, and is owned 49 percent by Ansett and 51 percent by Australian institutions.

Ansett Australia is owned equally by media group News Corp Ltd and Air New Zealand posted a small profit for the third quarter to March 31, while Ansett International reported a loss, News Corp said said in its results statement for the quarter.
